## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`preview` needs a fix before merge: its containment check compares paths as text without resolving them, so `..` segments and symlinks can read files outside the home directory.

## Changes
This pull request adds `preview` to `app/paths.py`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under the home directory, and `settings_file`, which returns `<home>/settings.toml`. It also adds tests for both helpers and a one-line text file at `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the is_relative_to check — `preview(home, "../../etc/passwd")` passes the check and reads a file outside home, because `Path.is_relative_to` only compares path segments as text and does not collapse `..`; a symlink inside home that points outside also passes. The only outside-path test, `tests/test_paths.py:20`, uses an absolute path, so it misses this case. — Any caller that passes user-supplied relative paths to `preview` exposes files outside the selected home directory. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, and add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
